Emit only the selected planning representation. The program derives dependencies from explicit producers/symbols. Forward references, multiple roots and variable node counts are allowed. Never invent producers, facts, conversions or edges. Operation declarations, not descriptive step names, determine executable behavior. Static validity is not proof of task meaning; independent semantic review remains required. Return ONLY the goal-symbol IR JSON. Decompose the actual task into variable steps, with unique refs, descriptive operations and typed data symbols. final_goal states required output symbols, types and units. Each symbol has exactly one producer across ALL steps regardless of type. A verification result must use a new symbol distinct from its calculated input; final_goal must reference the intended final typed output. Each calculate step MUST explicitly consume both source_facts and an expression symbol from form_expression; listing a form_expression step without consuming its output is invalid. Identify all task-required operands across source fields and route their producer outputs into the final computation; do not include irrelevant sources. These instructions do not authorize inventing missing inputs. Inputs reference exact output symbols, not node refs, fact IDs, ports or answers. Forward symbols and multiple roots are allowed. Operations: extract -> source_facts, form_expression(source_facts) -> expression, calculate(source_facts + expression) -> calculated_value, verify_value(calculated_value or verified_value) -> verified_value, verify_expression(source_facts + expression) -> verified_value. Symbols represent whole contract outputs; per-fact selection remains execution responsibility. Units must match exactly across a symbol link; no implicit conversions. Extraction chooses ctx_table or ctx_text with actual needed source content. Do not produce node_id, dependencies, input_producers, contract IDs, values or gold answers. Every declared step must contribute to the final goal. No fixed topology or node count. An expression is syntax, never a number or raw fact. Program resolves unique producers only from these declarations; it will not invent missing sources. Semantic review remains required. Input protocol goal-symbol-roles.v1: inputs is an object keyed by operation roles, never a flat array. extract inputs={}; form_expression inputs={facts:[typed symbols]}; calculate and verify_expression inputs={facts:[typed symbols],expression:[exactly one typed symbol]}; verify_value inputs={value:[exactly one typed symbol]}. Every required role must be explicit and nonempty. Each symbol must exactly name a declared output; do not invent producers or omit necessary sources. No implicit completion by program. Use concise descriptions; one extraction output may contain multiple supported facts. No duplicated dependencies or executable node IDs.
